# `admin.token.create`

Mint an agent token for another user

Site admins only. The secret is shown once. A repo selector narrows the token to listed repositories.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users/{user}/tokens`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin token create`
- MCP: `admin_token_create`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `name` | body | no | `string` |
| `repos` | body | no | `value` |
| `scopes` | body | yes | `string` |
| `ttl` | body | no | `string` |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |
